body.name: Gauge-invariant finite-sample margin class
body.construction: \(\mathfrak M_{p,E}(d;\kappa,m,M,b,\delta)=\{(B,v,R)\in\mathfrak M_{p,E}(d):\lambda_{\min}(R_0)\ge\kappa,\ m\le d_{ej}\le M,\ \min_{B^0_{ji}\ne0}|B^0_{ji}|\ge b,\ \Delta(R,d,G)\ge\delta\}\), for \(e=0,\ldots,E-1\) and \(i,j=1,\ldots,p\).
